__doc: OnboardingWizard: welcome copy, business-shape branches (Own / OEM / Both / Skip), shadow-brand intake step, onboarding tooltips.
welcomeDescription: Before we start tracking, we'd like to quickly learn how <1>{{clientName}}</1> is structured.
question: How does your brand appear in the market?

branches.ownDesc: AI directly mentions our brand name (e.g. Xiaomi, Huawei, Roborock).
branches.oemDesc: Our product is sold under a reseller's / retail platform's brand.
branches.bothDesc: Own brand + also sold through resellers.
branches.skipDesc: Take a look around first, come back to settings later.

oemStep.prompt: Let's start by entering the first shadow brand your product is sold under — you can add more later.
oemStep.shadowBrandPlaceholder: e.g. a channel brand / Amazon / JD Self-operated
oemStep.nextHint: Afterwards you can go to the <1>Peers</1> tab to add competing SKUs sold on the same channel — this step is optional and you can come back anytime.

toasts.shadowBrandSaveFailed: Failed to save the shadow brand, but onboarding is complete — you can add it manually in Settings: {{message}}

tooltips.onboardingOwn: AI will mention your brand name directly. Typical customers: Roborock, Xiaomi — brands with their own site and consumer recognition.
tooltips.onboardingOem: Your product is not sold to end customers under your company name but under a reseller's / distributor's brand (typical case: ODM manufacturers selling via Amazon / Walmart / channel brands).
tooltips.onboardingBoth: You own a brand and also sell through third-party platforms like Amazon / Walmart — you need to track both your own brand and the channel dimension.
tooltips.onboardingSkip: Skip onboarding and enter the system. You can finish brand and topic configuration in Settings at any time; onboarding won't appear again automatically.
tooltips.onboardingBusinessShape: Pick the option that best describes how your brand shows up in the market — the data definitions and recommendations adapt accordingly. You can change this anytime in Settings.
tooltips.onboardingShadowBrandName: The brand name your product is visibly sold under on this channel (the exact name that appears in AI answers, e.g. Amazon Basics, Rough Country).
tooltips.onboardingShadowAlias: Common abbreviations or alternate spellings for this shadow brand (e.g. RC, AMZ). Add any form AI answers might use.
